title: Home Mortgage Loans: Payoff Statement, Lien Release and Escrow Refund Timelines
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Payoff Statement, Lien Release and Escrow Refund Timelines

When a borrower pays off one of the Home Mortgage Loans, several program-level time limits come into play. This timeline card lists them for every program: how quickly a payoff statement is sent and what it costs, how soon the deed of trust satisfaction is recorded, and how soon leftover escrow is returned.

## The timeline values

- **Payoff statement turnaround** — business days after a request inside which the statement is sent.
- **Payoff statement fee** — the dollar charge for producing the statement.
- **Lien satisfaction** — calendar days after the payoff inside which the satisfaction of the deed of trust is recorded.
- **Escrow refund after payoff** — calendar days after the payoff inside which the escrow money still held is refunded.

| Program | Payoff statement turnaround (business days) | Payoff statement fee (USD) | Lien satisfaction (calendar days) | Escrow refund after payoff (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 | 0.00 | 30 | 30 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 | 0.00 | 30 | 30 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 | 0.00 | 30 | 30 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 | 0.00 | 30 | 30 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 7 | 0.00 | 30 | 30 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 7 | 0.00 | 30 | 30 |

## Observations

- The values are uniform: every program sends the statement within 7 business days, charges nothing for it, records the satisfaction within 30 calendar days and refunds escrow within 30 calendar days.
- The statement clock runs in business days; the two post-payoff clocks run in calendar days.
